record.name: VIRAL - One whisper, a living town
record.summary: AI-driven town simulation: whisper a sentence to a resident and watch its consequences. Gemma on AMD generates character reactions; a deterministic engine validates actions and records causal events.
record.contribution: Public project in RoyWG925's account. Individual versus team ownership of specific components remains unconfirmed.
results: Repository README reports 157 tests in 16 suites for validators, engine invariants and scripted-model behavior. Command: node --test lab/test-*.ts. This count was not independently rerun in phase 2.
limitations: The 157-test figure is repository-reported at commit cbab86c5b978cfa522cf2c3307a8bad236e2db49; no new test execution is claimed.
Live model latency varies; peak-time stories may take several minutes. Human entertainment/playtesting evidence is not established.
Roy confirms completed and submitted to AMD Developer Hackathon ACT III on 2026-10-19; results pending. Individual component ownership and team attribution need confirmation.
lessons: Separate model-generated decisions from deterministic state changes and make failures observable.

discovery.reason: Capture implemented agent/simulation architecture, actual dependency versions and scoped repository-reported test evidence. Preserve owner-attested submission and pending results.

claims.quote: Every model answer is JSON that the engine parses, normalises and validates

discovery.notes: Source inspected by Codex Work; project code/tests were not executed in this review. Personal/team attribution remains pending.
